description: Windkraftanlagen im Land Brandenburg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB). The database contains the point data on operated, approved and not yet commissioned and planned wind turbines in the state of Brandenburg from the LIS-A system information system. Coverage: the state of Brandenburg (LGB). The portal shows the English title as "Wind turbines in Brandenburg" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB). Its keywords include ENVI, und, Energie, opendata. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2026-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
